outcome: The shared native wait operation lifecycle is implemented and verified in focused coverage and public source-bound normal waits; the sole authorized source event did not create a native decision, so a real live operation interruption is not proved.
summary: The cockpit now correlates an accepted wait operation across menu, duration, activity, and World surfaces instead of treating currently advertised activity controls as recipe intent. Both raw wait and the existing keep-watch consumer use the shared collector. A current R033 C-4 source event produced real Deaf/ringing-ears evidence but left the World owner intact and both operations completed, while R013 is prelaunch-blocked by a missing retained save. The correction is a lifecycle implementation success with a bounded live-evidence finding, not product acceptance.
